title: carya ovata f. fraxinifolia
intro: Carya ovata f. fraxinifolia, commonly known as the Shagbark Hickory, is a deciduous tree species native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health due to its prebiotic properties. The therapeutic actions of Carya ovata f. fraxinifolia include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and optimal uses.
